_comment: CROSS Wave-3 (2026-05-19) — default runtime language-architecture config applied by brain_daemon.py after every brain create/load. Every flag below is RUNTIME-ONLY in the C library (not persisted in nimcp_brain_save). This file is the source of truth for how the cascade behaves on daemon start. Override per-deployment by placing a JSON at /etc/athena/runtime_lang_config.json or pointing the LANG_CONFIG env var at an alternate file. Set LANG_CONFIG=off to skip the apply entirely.
_slice_1: iterative cascade convergence — orchestrator only, no flag here; max_iters is per-call
_slice_2_arcuate: Wernicke<->Broca arcuate feedback. No public setter on this branch (lives on brain->arcuate_feedback_strength, written only by the recurrent loop itself). Listed here for documentation.
_deprecated_option1_rebuild: trigram_learning_enabled / ltd_margin / comprehend_stdp_enabled / da_modulation_enabled / da_modulation_gain were removed when the SNN-language bridge became transport-only (Option-1 rebuild, 2026-05-19). The daemon no longer applies them (not in _apply_runtime_lang_config) and their RPC handlers return 'deprecated'. Dropped from this file (walkthrough R3, 2026-05-27) so they no longer imply active tuning.
_slice_4_lateral_inhibition: K-WTA over lexical cohort. Default ON with divisive-norm tunables p=2.0 (gain_self repurposed as exponent) and eps=1e-6 (gain_inhibit repurposed as denominator floor). See S4-C1 in cascade.c.
_slice_5_phonological_loop: Baddeley working-memory phonological store + articulatory rehearsal. Default ON with biologically-reasonable decay/threshold.
_slice_6_thalamic_gates: Per-stage pulvinar-style gain. Default ON; the recurrent loop computes weights from arousal+attention each cascade run. Manual overrides via thalamic_gate_overrides{stage_idx: weight}.
_slice_7_cerebellar_correction: Predict + climbing-fiber LTD via existing cerebellum adapter. Default OFF until forward-model has had enough training to clear the confidence>0.3 gate (S7-H2). Operators flip on once cereb_motor_confidence stabilizes >0.3 in lang_status.
_produce_and_nlp_flags: Default-OFF developmental features (walkthrough R1/R2, 2026-05-27). Previously absent from this file, so they had no enable knob on the pod (the daemon's _apply_runtime_lang_config skips absent keys). Listed here at their current default (false) so an operator can flip them on per-deployment via /etc/athena/runtime_lang_config.json. reason_in_content is Tier-1 Step E; the produce_* trio is Tier-2 coherence; coref/subword are NLP-2/NLP-1. All re-applied from this file every daemon start (runtime-only, not in the checkpoint).
_producer_foundation: FND-1 (2026-05-27): produce_clause_frame builds a real SVO clause (predicate + agent/patient) from the grounded top-K instead of a reranked content-word bag. Default false; effective at stage>=2, falls back to greedy emit on weak signal. The first 'strengthen the producer foundation' slice.
_produce_score_rebalance: Produce-score rebalance (2026-05-27): produce_distributional_weight is the weight on the distributional (context-vector) term vs the concept-binding term in produce word scoring (raw = w*distributional + (1-w)*concept). Default 0.4 = historical 0.4/0.6 split. Raise toward ~0.7 so concrete intent-correct words outrank the broad abstract cluster whose wide concept bindings otherwise monopolize produce regardless of intent (diagnosed: produce collapsed to ~20 abstract nouns). Clamped [0,1].
_produce_frequency_penalty: Produce-score frequency penalty (2026-06-01): IDF-style damping of high-frequency words in produce scoring (raw *= 1/(1 + p*log1p(frequency))). Default 0.0 = OFF. Raise (~0.1-0.3) so distributionally-central technical-corpus vocab (gpu/impedance/lidar/...) stops monopolizing produce filler positions — the word-salad contamination diagnosed 2026-06-01. Runtime-only (applied from this file at daemon start; not LANC-persisted). p<0 clamped to 0.
_produce_via_snn: Increment-1 (2026-06-02): SNN-as-generator A/B switch. Default false. When true, grounded_language_produce sources candidate words from the SNN language bridge's per-tick Broca spike cache (decode_spikes_cached) instead of find_words_near_vector, with the lexicon producer as permanent fallback when the SNN yields no signal. The intent it decodes against is the cascade's cognitively-integrated content_intent, so all cognitive modules that reach content_intent drive SNN generation. Runtime-only (applied at daemon start).
_metacog_gates_produce: Metacognitive produce-floor modulation (2026-06-02). Default false. When true, cascade_stage_content shifts the produce confidence floor from world-model surprise (FEP prediction-error trajectory fep_pe_terminal/fep_pe_initial): a converged model lowers the floor (more willing to assert), a still-surprised model raises it (more 'I don't know'). This is the correct integration for the modulatory cognitive modules (emotion/introspection/world-model) which carry no semantic content vector for content_intent. Introspection confidence + wellbeing distress fold into the same adjust as follow-ons. Runtime-only.
_t3_givenness_definite: T3-1 (2026-05-28): produce_givenness_definite, default ON. gl_apply_givenness_definite runs in the surface cascade right AFTER T2 pronominalization and swaps the preceding 'a'/'an' to 'the' on a NOUN re-mention (recency window) that T2-1 did NOT pronominalize (person nouns, unanchored slots). Marks the second mention as given, which is the natural complement to T2-1/T2-3. Stage-gated >=2 inside the helper. Conservative + idempotent so ON-by-default is safe — operators can flip false per-deployment.
_t3_conjunction: T3-2 (2026-05-29): produce_t3_conjunction, default ON. gl_apply_t3_conjunction runs AFTER T3-1 in the cascade. Scans for the first adjacent SVO pair (VERB ... DET-or-NOUN ... VERB) and inserts 'and' before the second clause's leading determiner/noun unless that token is already a connective (and/but/so/or/then/while/because/although). Single insert per pass, idempotent on re-run. Stage-gated >=2. Conservative — leaves output unchanged when the pattern isn't detected, so ON-by-default is safe.
_tf_feedback: TF-2 (2026-05-28): Tier-feedback plasticity — the cascade-delta diff feeds back into NN training so the network eventually internalizes the corrected form. produce_corrector_feedback_enabled default true; tf_enabled_correctors default 31 (all five bits: 1=F3, 2=F4, 4=T2-1, 8=T3-1, 16=T3-2). Trigram + distributional EMA fire at their default lrs (0.002 / 0.01) on every cascade pass that the outcome gate (stage>=2, DA>=0, no speech-repair retry, fresh reward) passes. Bridge STDP stays at 0.0 EVEN WHEN MASTER IS ON — TF-5 walkthrough required before raising. Per-path max: trigram 0.05, distrib 0.1, bridge stdp 0.1. Flip the master to false to disable TF entirely.
